source.text: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἐξῆλθεν δόγμα παρὰ Καίσαρος Αὐγούστου ἀπογράφεσθαι πᾶσαν τὴν οἰκουμένην·

records.literal_gloss: It came to pass then in the days those went out a decree from Caesar Augustus to be registered all the inhabited world;

en.L: And it happened in those days [that] a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the inhabited world should be registered.
en.B: In those days an order went out from Caesar Augustus that a register should be made of the whole empire.
en.R: At that time the Roman emperor, Caesar Augustus, gave an order. Everyone in the lands he ruled had to be listed in a record.

es.L: Y sucedió en aquellos días [que] salió un decreto de César Augusto: que todo el mundo habitado fuera registrado.
es.B: En aquellos días, César Augusto dio la orden de que se hiciera un registro de todo el imperio.
es.R: En ese tiempo, el emperador romano César Augusto dio una orden. Todas las personas de los países que él gobernaba tenían que quedar anotadas en una lista.

fr.L: Et il arriva en ces jours-là qu’un décret sortit de la part de César Auguste, [ordonnant] que soit recensée toute la terre habitée.
fr.B: En ce temps-là parut un décret de César Auguste ordonnant le recensement de tout l’empire.
fr.R: À cette époque, l’empereur romain, César Auguste, a donné un ordre. Tous les habitants des pays qu’il gouvernait devaient se faire inscrire sur une liste.

sw.L: Basi ilitokea katika siku hizo agizo lilitoka kwa Kaisari Augusto kwamba dunia yote inayokaliwa iandikishwe.
sw.B: Siku hizo Kaisari Augusto alitoa agizo kwamba ifanyike orodha ya watu wa himaya nzima.
sw.R: Wakati huo mfalme mkuu wa Kirumi, Kaisari Augusto, alitoa amri. Kila mtu katika nchi alizozitawala alipaswa kuandikwa katika orodha.

ko.L: 그리고 [이런] 일이 있었다. 그 날들에 가이사 아구스도에게서 칙령이 나왔는데, 사람이 사는 온 세상이 호적에 등록하라는 것이었다.
ko.B: 그 무렵 가이사 아구스도 황제가 온 제국에 호적을 등록하라는 명령을 내렸다.
ko.R: 그때 로마 황제 가이사 아구스도가 명령을 내렸다. 그가 다스리는 모든 땅의 사람들은 이름을 명단에 올려야 한다는 것이었다.

vi.L: Và xảy ra trong những ngày ấy, có chiếu chỉ từ Sê-sa Au-gút-tơ ban ra để cả thiên hạ phải được ghi tên vào sổ.
vi.B: Trong những ngày ấy, Sê-sa Au-gút-tơ ra chiếu chỉ lập sổ đăng ký cho toàn thể đế quốc.
vi.R: Lúc ấy, hoàng đế La Mã là Sê-sa Au-gút-tơ ra lệnh: mọi người trong các xứ ông cai trị đều phải ghi tên vào sổ.

pt.L: E aconteceu, naqueles dias, [que] saiu um decreto da parte de César Augusto para que todo o mundo habitado fosse recenseado.
pt.B: Naqueles dias, saiu de César Augusto uma ordem para que se fizesse o recenseamento de todo o império.
pt.R: Naquela época, o imperador romano, César Augusto, deu uma ordem. Todas as pessoas das terras que ele governava tinham de ser registradas numa lista.

am.L: በእነዚያም ቀኖች እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ሰው የሚኖርበት ዓለም ሁሉ እንዲመዘገብ ከቄሳር አውግስጦስ ትእዛዝ ወጣ።
am.B: በዚያን ዘመን በግዛቱ ሁሉ ያሉ ሰዎች እንዲመዘገቡ ከቄሳር አውግስጦስ ትእዛዝ ወጣ።
am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ የሮም ንጉሠ ነገሥት ቄሳር አውግስጦስ ትእዛዝ አወጣ። በሚገዛቸው አገሮች ያለ ሰው ሁሉ በመዝገብ መጻፍ ነበረበት።

ru.L: И было в те дни, вышло повеление от кесаря Августа провести перепись всей обитаемой земли.
ru.B: В те дни вышел указ кесаря Августа провести перепись по всей империи.
ru.R: В то время римский император кесарь Август издал приказ. Всех людей во всех землях, которыми он правил, нужно было записать в списки.

hi.L: और उन दिनों में ऐसा हुआ कि औगूस्तुस कैसर की ओर से आज्ञा निकली कि सारी बसी हुई दुनिया के नाम लिखे जाएँ।
hi.B: उन दिनों औगूस्तुस कैसर की ओर से आदेश निकला कि सारे साम्राज्य के लोगों के नाम लिखे जाएँ।
hi.R: उस समय रोम के सम्राट औगूस्तुस कैसर ने एक आदेश दिया। उसके राज्य के सब देशों में हर व्यक्ति का नाम एक सूची में लिखा जाना था।

uk.L: І сталося в ті дні, [що] вийшов наказ від кесаря Августа переписати всю населену землю.
uk.B: Тими днями вийшов наказ кесаря Августа провести перепис по всій імперії.
uk.R: У той час римський імператор, кесар Август, видав наказ. Усіх людей у землях, якими він правив, мали записати до списку.

ja.L: そして、それらの日々に[次のことが]起こった。皇帝アウグストゥスから、人の住む全世界が登録されるようにという勅令が出た。
ja.B: そのころ、皇帝アウグストゥスから、帝国全土の住民を登録せよという命令が出た。
ja.R: そのころ、ローマ皇帝アウグストゥスが命令を出しました。皇帝が治めている国々のすべての人が、名簿に名前を載せなければならない、というのです。

decisions.choice: Caesar Augustus: the first Roman emperor, who ruled from 27 BC to AD 14
decisions.reason: "Caesar" was the family name of Julius Caesar, taken by the emperors after him; "Augustus" ("revered") was a title the Senate gave Octavian. Luke sets the birth of Jesus in world history, under the most powerful ruler of the age.

decisions.choice: all the inhabited world: the Roman Empire
decisions.reason: The word means the inhabited world, and was used for the lands under Roman rule (Acts 11:28; 24:5).

decisions.choice: be registered: be entered on a list, a census for taxation
decisions.reason: The verb means to enroll or write down in a public list. Roman censuses were taken to assess taxes. No source outside Luke tells of a single decree for the whole empire at this time; Augustus did order censuses of Roman citizens and of provinces, and Luke may mean the policy as it reached Judea.

decisions.choice: the whole empire (B); everyone in the lands he ruled (R)
decisions.reason: "The whole world" would mislead modern readers; Balanced and Readable say which world is meant.

decisions.choice: registrar, registro (L, B); quedar anotadas en una lista (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is entering names on an official list (meaning decision m3). "Empadronar" is the familiar word in older Spanish Bibles; "registrar" says the same in everyday Spanish. The same through 2:5.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R)
decisions.reason: As in John and Mark: the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative in French and suits a careful public reading; the passé composé is how French is spoken and how young readers meet stories, so Readable uses it throughout. Speech (the angel, Simeon, Mary, Jesus) keeps its own tenses at every level. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: recenser, le recensement (L, B); se faire inscrire sur une liste (R)
decisions.reason: "Recensement" is the usual French word for an official count and registration of a population; it does not say whether the purpose was taxation, which m3 leaves uncertain. Readable says what the registration was in everyday words, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: iandikishwe (L); ifanyike orodha (B); kuandikwa katika orodha (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is entering names on an official list (meaning decision m3). "Kuandikisha" is the everyday word for registering, as for voters; "sensa" would narrow it to a modern head count. The same through 2:5.

decisions.choice: Protestant name forms "가이사 아구스도", "구레뇨"; "시리아" for Syria; "호적 등록" (L, B), "이름을 명단에 올리다" (R) for the registration
decisions.reason: Names follow the Protestant tradition (style guide, Settled), as "가이사" in the Korean John 19:12. "시리아" is the current name of the region and is the form the Korean Luke 4:27 uses; "수리아" is the older Bible spelling. "호적 등록" is the usual Korean for a census of households; Readable says what was done.

decisions.choice: "Sê-sa Au-gút-tơ"
decisions.reason: "Sê-sa" as in John 19:12 and Mark 12:14; "Au-gút-tơ" is the Protestant transliteration of Augustus.

decisions.choice: "cả thiên hạ" for "all the inhabited world" (L); "toàn thể đế quốc" (B)
decisions.reason: "thiên hạ" is the old Vietnamese word for the whole inhabited world under a ruler, close to the Greek; "thế giới" would suggest the whole globe. The meaning decision says the Roman Empire is meant, which Balanced says.

decisions.choice: recensear, o recenseamento
decisions.reason: "Recenseamento" is the Portuguese word for an official count and listing of a population (m3); "alistamento" now suggests enlisting in the army. Readable says plainly that people were put on a list.

decisions.choice: 'кесарь Август'
decisions.reason: 'Кесарь' is the Russian Bible form of Caesar, as the style guide settles; Readable adds that he was the Roman emperor.

decisions.choice: "औगूस्तुस कैसर"
decisions.reason: The established Hindi Bible form of the name, with "कैसर" as in Matthew and Mark. Quirinius in 2:2 is "क्विरिनियुस".

decisions.choice: "переписати" (L), "перепис" (B), "записати до списку" (R)
decisions.reason: "Перепис" is the ordinary Ukrainian word for a census and is kept through 2:1-5; Readable says what was done in plain words.

decisions.choice: "皇帝アウグストゥス" (L, B); "ローマ皇帝アウグストゥス" (R)
alternatives: "カイサル・アウグストゥス"
"カエサル・アウグストゥス"
decisions.reason: Caesar here is the emperor's title, so Japanese puts it as 皇帝 before the name, the Gospels' term for Caesar. Readable adds ローマ so that a new reader knows whose emperor.

decisions.choice: "登録される" (L); "登録せよ" (B); "名簿に名前を載せる" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is to be entered on a public list (m3). 登録 keeps that sense through the chapter (2:2, 3, 5); Readable says in plain words what was done.

source.text: αὕτη ἀπογραφὴ πρώτη ἐγένετο ἡγεμονεύοντος τῆς Συρίας Κυρηνίου·

records.literal_gloss: This registration first took place governing the Syria Quirinius;

en.L: This was [the] first registration, [taken] while Quirinius was governing Syria.
en.B: This was the first registration, and it took place while Quirinius was governor of Syria.
en.R: This was the first time a list like this was made. Quirinius was ruling Syria then.

es.L: Este fue [el] primer registro, [hecho] mientras Quirinio gobernaba Siria.
es.B: Este fue el primer registro, y se hizo cuando Quirinio era gobernador de Siria.
es.R: Era la primera vez que se hacía una lista así. En ese tiempo Quirinio gobernaba Siria.

fr.L: Ce recensement fut le premier, [fait] pendant que Quirinius gouvernait la Syrie.
fr.B: Ce fut le premier recensement ; il eut lieu quand Quirinius était gouverneur de Syrie.
fr.R: C’était la première fois qu’on faisait une liste comme celle-là. À ce moment-là, Quirinius gouvernait la Syrie.

sw.L: Uandikishaji huu ulikuwa wa kwanza, [uliofanyika] wakati Kwirinio alipokuwa akitawala Siria.
sw.B: Huu ulikuwa uandikishaji wa kwanza, nao ulifanyika wakati Kwirinio alipokuwa gavana wa Siria.
sw.R: Hii ilikuwa mara ya kwanza orodha ya namna hii kufanywa. Wakati huo Kwirinio alikuwa akitawala Siria.

ko.L: 이것은 구레뇨가 시리아를 다스리고 있을 때 [있었던] 첫 번째 호적 등록이었다.
ko.B: 이것은 구레뇨가 시리아 총독으로 있을 때 처음 실시한 호적 등록이었다.
ko.R: 이렇게 명단을 만든 것은 이번이 처음이었다. 그때 구레뇨가 시리아를 다스리고 있었다.

vi.L: Đây là cuộc đăng ký đầu tiên, [diễn ra] khi Qui-ri-ni-u làm tổng đốc Sy-ri.
vi.B: Đây là cuộc đăng ký đầu tiên, diễn ra khi Qui-ri-ni-u làm tổng đốc xứ Sy-ri.
vi.R: Đây là lần đầu tiên có một cuộc ghi tên như vậy. Lúc ấy Qui-ri-ni-u đang cai trị xứ Sy-ri.

pt.L: Este foi [o] primeiro recenseamento, [feito] quando Quirino governava a Síria.
pt.B: Esse primeiro recenseamento ocorreu no tempo em que Quirino governava a Síria.
pt.R: Foi a primeira vez que se fez uma lista assim. Naquela época, Quirino governava a Síria.

am.L: ቄሬኔዎስ በሶርያ ላይ ገዢ ሳለ ይህ የመጀመሪያው ምዝገባ ነበረ።
am.B: ይህ የመጀመሪያው ምዝገባ ነበረ፤ የተደረገውም ቄሬኔዎስ የሶርያ አገረ ገዢ በነበረበት ጊዜ ነው።
am.R: እንዲህ ያለ መዝገብ ሲዘጋጅ ይህ የመጀመሪያው ነበረ። በዚያን ጊዜ ሶርያን ይገዛ የነበረው ቄሬኔዎስ ነበረ።

ru.L: Эта перепись была первой, [проводимая], когда Сирией управлял Квириний.
ru.B: Это была первая перепись, и проходила она, когда наместником Сирии был Квириний.
ru.R: Такой список составляли тогда впервые. В это время Сирией правил Квириний.

hi.L: यह पहली नाम-लिखाई थी, [जो] उस समय [हुई] जब क्विरिनियुस सीरिया पर शासन कर रहा था।
hi.B: यह पहली नाम-लिखाई थी, और यह तब हुई जब क्विरिनियुस सीरिया का राज्यपाल था।
hi.R: इस तरह की सूची पहली बार बनाई जा रही थी। उस समय क्विरिनियुस सीरिया पर राज करता था।

uk.L: Цей перепис був першим, [проведеним], коли Сирією правив Квіріній.
uk.B: Це був перший перепис, і відбувся він тоді, коли правителем Сирії був Квіріній.
uk.R: Такий список складали тоді вперше. У той час Сирією правив Квіріній.

ja.L: これは、キリニウスがシリアを治めていたときに[行われた]最初の登録であった。
ja.B: これは最初の登録であり、キリニウスがシリア州の総督であったときに行われた。
ja.R: このような名簿が作られたのは、これが初めてでした。そのころ、キリニウスがシリア州を治めていました。

decisions.choice: Quirinius governing Syria: the Roman official in charge of the province of Syria, to which Judea was later joined
decisions.reason: Publius Sulpicius Quirinius governed Syria from AD 6, when he held a census in Judea after Herod's son Archelaus was removed (compare Acts 5:37). Jesus was born before Herod died in 4 BC (1:5; Matthew 2:1). How the two dates fit is a known problem; see the next decision.

decisions.choice: first registration: the first of the censuses, or a registration before the one under Quirinius
decisions.reason: The Greek can mean "this was the first registration while Quirinius governed", or, as some read it, "this registration took place before Quirinius governed". The second would remove the conflict with the date of AD 6, but it is a less usual sense of the word. Others suggest Quirinius held an earlier office in the region. The question is open.

decisions.choice: "Qui-ri-ni-u", "tổng đốc", "Sy-ri"
decisions.reason: The Protestant transliteration; "tổng đốc" is the word used for Pilate's office in John 18:28, and "Sy-ri" is as in Mark 7:26.

decisions.choice: 'наместник' (B)
decisions.reason: As settled in Matthew, a Roman governor is 'наместник'.

decisions.choice: "キリニウス"; "シリア" (L), "シリア州" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Quirinius is transliterated from the Latin-based Greek form, as the Gospel name list has it. Syria is the Roman province, so Balanced and Readable say シリア州, as Acts does.

source.text: καὶ ἐπορεύοντο πάντες ἀπογράφεσθαι, ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν ἑαυτοῦ πόλιν.

records.literal_gloss: And were going all to be registered, each to the of himself city.

en.L: And all were going to be registered, each to {{gender:their|his}} own city.
en.B: Everyone set out to be registered, each in their own town.
en.R: So everyone went to their own hometown to have their name put on the list.

es.L: Y todos iban a registrarse, cada uno a su propia ciudad.
es.B: Todos se pusieron en camino para registrarse, cada uno en su propio pueblo.
es.R: Así que todos fueron a su propio pueblo de origen para que anotaran su nombre en la lista.

fr.L: Et tous allaient se faire recenser, chacun dans sa propre ville.
fr.B: Tout le monde partit se faire recenser, chacun dans sa ville.
fr.R: Alors tout le monde est allé dans sa ville d’origine pour se faire inscrire sur la liste.

sw.L: Na wote walikuwa wakienda kuandikishwa, kila mmoja kwenda mji wake mwenyewe.
sw.B: Watu wote waliondoka kwenda kuandikishwa, kila mtu katika mji wake.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo kila mtu alikwenda katika mji wake wa asili ili jina lake liandikwe katika orodha.

ko.L: 그리고 모든 사람이 등록하러 각자 자기 성읍으로 가고 있었다.
ko.B: 그래서 모든 사람이 등록하려고 저마다 자기 고향으로 떠났다.
ko.R: 그래서 사람들은 모두 이름을 명단에 올리려고 자기 고향으로 갔다.

vi.L: Và mọi người đều đi đăng ký, ai nấy về thành của mình.
vi.B: Mọi người đều lên đường đi đăng ký, ai về thành nấy.
vi.R: Vì vậy ai nấy đều về quê mình để ghi tên vào sổ.

pt.L: E todos iam se registrar, cada um na sua própria cidade.
pt.B: Todos partiram para se registrar, cada um na sua cidade.
pt.R: Por isso, todos foram para a sua cidade de origem, para pôr o nome na lista.

am.L: ሁሉም ሊመዘገቡ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ገዛ ከተማው ይሄድ ነበር።
am.B: ሁሉም ለመመዝገብ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ራሱ ከተማ ሄደ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ሰው ሁሉ ስሙን በመዝገቡ ለማስጻፍ ወደ ትውልድ ከተማው ሄደ።

ru.L: И шли все записываться, каждый в свой город.
ru.B: Все отправились записываться, каждый в свой город.
ru.R: И все пошли в свои родные города, чтобы их имена внесли в список.

hi.L: और सब नाम लिखवाने के लिए अपने-अपने नगर को जा रहे थे।
hi.B: सब लोग नाम लिखवाने के लिए अपने-अपने नगर को चल पड़े।
hi.R: इसलिए हर कोई अपना नाम सूची में लिखवाने के लिए अपने-अपने पुश्तैनी नगर को गया।

uk.L: І йшли всі, щоб записатися, кожен до свого міста.
uk.B: Усі вирушали на перепис, кожен до свого міста.
uk.R: Тож кожен ішов до свого рідного міста, щоб його записали до списку.

ja.L: そしてすべての人が、登録されるために、それぞれ自分の町へ向かって行った。
ja.B: 人々はみな登録のために、それぞれ自分の町へ出かけて行った。
ja.R: それで、人々はみな、名簿に名前を載せてもらうために、自分のふるさとの町へ行きました。

decisions.choice: each to his own town: the town of his family's origin, where he held property or rights
alternatives: the town where he was born
decisions.reason: A Roman census in Egypt (AD 104) ordered people to return to their homes for registration. Joseph goes to the town of his ancestor David (2:4), where his family may still have held land.

decisions.choice: no gender span on "cada uno ... su propia ciudad"
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender span (their/his). Spanish "cada uno" is the ordinary generic form and "su" does not mark gender, so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: chacun dans sa propre ville, with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span on the possessive
decisions.reason: English Literal needs a gender setting ("their" / "his") for the possessive. French "chacun ... sa" is already generic and the possessive agrees with "ville", not with the person, so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: no gender span on "kila mmoja ... mji wake"
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender span (their/his). Swahili "wake" means his or her, so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: "각자 자기 성읍으로" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs "their|his"; Korean "자기" is the same for women and men, so there is nothing for the setting to change (also 2:14 and 2:52, "사람들").

decisions.choice: "ai nấy ... của mình" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs a span for "their/his"; Vietnamese "ai nấy" and "mình" are not marked for gender, so there is nothing to switch.

decisions.choice: cada um na sua própria cidade, with no gender setting
alternatives: {{gender:cada um na sua|cada homem na sua}}
decisions.reason: The English Literal needs a setting for "their" or "his". Portuguese "cada um ... sua" already covers men and women, so no setting is needed.

decisions.choice: ወደ ገዛ ከተማው (each to his own town), with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span on the possessive suffix
decisions.reason: The Amharic generic suffix (-ው, "his") after "እያንዳንዱ" (each one) already includes women, so the reader's gender setting has nothing to change. The same holds in this chapter for "ሰዎች" where the English has a gender span (2:14, 2:52).

decisions.choice: 'каждый в свой город', no setting
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: The English needs a choice between 'their' and 'his'. Russian 'каждый в свой' uses the reflexive, which has no gender, so no span is needed. The same holds for 'люди' in 2:14 and 2:52.

decisions.choice: "अपने-अपने" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English offers "their" or "his" for each person's own town. The Hindi reflexive "अपने-अपने" has no gender, so there is nothing for the setting to change; likewise "लोगों" (2:14) and "मनुष्यों" (2:52) already include women and men.

decisions.choice: "кожен до свого міста" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender setting as in the English
decisions.reason: Ukrainian "кожен" with "свій" already includes everyone, so the English setting has nothing to change here.

decisions.choice: "自分の" with no gender span
alternatives: a span such as {{gender:自分の|彼の}}
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender span on "their/his". Japanese 自分 already includes men and women, so no span is needed.

source.text: Ἀνέβη δὲ καὶ Ἰωσὴφ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἐκ πόλεως Ναζαρὲθ εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν εἰς πόλιν Δαυὶδ ἥτις καλεῖται Βηθλέεμ, διὰ τὸ εἶναι αὐτὸν ἐξ οἴκου καὶ πατριᾶς Δαυίδ, ἀπογράψασθαι σὺν Μαριὰμ τῇ ἐμνηστευμένῃ αὐτῷ, οὔσῃ ἐγκύῳ.

records.literal_gloss: Went up then also Joseph from the Galilee out of city Nazareth to the Judea to city of David which is called Bethlehem, because of the being him of house and family of David, \v 5 to be registered with Mary the [one] betrothed to him, being pregnant.

en.L: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of [the] town of Nazareth, to Judea, to [the] city of David which is called Bethlehem, because he was of [the] house and family of David, \v 5 to be registered with Mary, who was betrothed to him, being pregnant.
en.B: So Joseph too went up from Nazareth in Galilee to Judea, to David's town, Bethlehem, since he was from the house and clan of David. \v 5 He went to be registered together with Mary, who was engaged to him and was expecting a child.
en.R: Joseph lived in the town of Nazareth in Galilee. He was from the family of King David, so he had to go to Bethlehem in Judea, the town where David was born. \v 5 He went there with Mary to be put on the list. Mary was engaged to Joseph, and she was pregnant.

es.L: Y subió también José desde Galilea, de [la] ciudad de Nazaret, a Judea, a [la] ciudad de David que se llama Belén, por ser él de [la] casa y familia de David, \v 5 para registrarse con María, que estaba comprometida con él, estando embarazada.
es.B: Así que también José subió de Nazaret, en Galilea, a Judea, al pueblo de David, Belén, porque era de la casa y del clan de David. \v 5 Fue a registrarse junto con María, que estaba comprometida con él y esperaba un hijo.
es.R: José vivía en el pueblo de Nazaret, en Galilea. Era de la familia del rey David, así que tenía que ir a Belén, en Judea, el pueblo donde nació David. \v 5 Fue allá con María para que los anotaran en la lista. María estaba comprometida para casarse con José, y estaba embarazada.

fr.L: Et Joseph aussi monta de Galilée, de la ville de Nazareth, en Judée, à la ville de David qui s’appelle Bethléem, parce qu’il était de la maison et de la famille de David, \v 5 pour se faire recenser avec Marie, qui lui était fiancée, [et qui était] enceinte.
fr.B: Joseph, lui aussi, monta de Nazareth, en Galilée, vers la Judée, jusqu’à la ville de David, Bethléem, car il appartenait à la maison et au clan de David. \v 5 Il alla se faire recenser avec Marie, sa fiancée, qui attendait un enfant.
fr.R: Joseph habitait la ville de Nazareth, en Galilée. Il était de la famille du roi David. C’est pourquoi il a dû aller à Bethléem, en Judée, la ville où David était né. \v 5 Il y est allé avec Marie pour se faire inscrire sur la liste. Marie était fiancée à Joseph, et elle était enceinte.

sw.L: Naye Yusufu pia alipanda kutoka Galilaya, kutoka mji wa Nazareti, kwenda Yudea, hadi mji wa Daudi uitwao Bethlehemu, kwa sababu yeye alikuwa wa nyumba na ukoo wa Daudi, \v 5 ili aandikishwe pamoja na Mariamu, aliyekuwa ameposwa naye, akiwa mjamzito.
sw.B: Basi Yusufu naye alipanda kutoka Nazareti ya Galilaya kwenda Yudea, mpaka mji wa Daudi, Bethlehemu, kwa kuwa alikuwa wa nyumba na ukoo wa Daudi. \v 5 Alienda kuandikishwa pamoja na Mariamu, ambaye alikuwa amechumbiwa naye, naye alikuwa akitarajia mtoto.
sw.R: Yusufu aliishi katika mji wa Nazareti huko Galilaya. Yeye alikuwa wa ukoo wa Mfalme Daudi, kwa hiyo ilimbidi aende Bethlehemu huko Yudea, mji alikozaliwa Daudi. \v 5 Alikwenda huko pamoja na Mariamu ili waandikwe katika orodha. Mariamu alikuwa amechumbiwa na Yusufu, naye alikuwa mjamzito.

ko.L: 그리고 요셉도 갈릴리 나사렛 성읍에서 유대로, 베들레헴이라고 불리는 다윗의 성읍으로 올라갔다. 그가 다윗의 집과 족속 출신이었기 때문이다. \v 5 [그는] 자기와 약혼한 마리아와 함께 등록하려고 [갔는데], 마리아는 임신 중이었다.
ko.B: 그래서 요셉도 갈릴리 나사렛 마을을 떠나 유대에 있는 다윗의 고향 베들레헴으로 올라갔다. 그는 다윗의 집안과 가문에 속한 사람이었기 때문이다. \v 5 요셉은 약혼자 마리아와 함께 등록하러 갔는데, 마리아는 아기를 가진 몸이었다.
ko.R: 요셉은 갈릴리 지방의 나사렛 마을에 살고 있었다. 그는 다윗 왕의 집안 사람이었기 때문에, 다윗이 태어난 마을인 유대 지방의 베들레헴으로 가야 했다. \v 5 요셉은 이름을 명단에 올리려고 마리아와 함께 그곳으로 갔다. 마리아는 요셉과 약혼한 사이였고, 아기를 가지고 있었다.

vi.L: Và Giô-sép cũng từ Ga-li-lê, ra khỏi thành Na-xa-rét, đi lên Giu-đê, đến thành Đa-vít gọi là Bết-lê-hem, vì ông thuộc nhà và dòng tộc Đa-vít, \v 5 để đăng ký cùng với Ma-ri, người đã đính hôn với ông, đang có thai.
vi.B: Vậy Giô-sép cũng từ Na-xa-rét, xứ Ga-li-lê, đi lên Giu-đê, đến Bết-lê-hem, thành của Đa-vít, vì ông thuộc nhà và dòng tộc Đa-vít. \v 5 Ông đi đăng ký cùng với Ma-ri, là người đã đính hôn với ông và đang mang thai.
vi.R: Giô-sép sống ở thị trấn Na-xa-rét, miền Ga-li-lê. Ông thuộc dòng dõi vua Đa-vít, nên ông phải đến Bết-lê-hem thuộc xứ Giu-đê, là thị trấn nơi Đa-vít sinh ra. \v 5 Ông đến đó cùng với Ma-ri để ghi tên vào sổ. Ma-ri đã đính hôn với Giô-sép, và cô đang có thai.

pt.L: E também José subiu da Galileia, da cidade de Nazaré, para a Judeia, para [a] cidade de Davi que se chama Belém, por ser ele da casa e da família de Davi, \v 5 para se registrar com Maria, que estava prometida em casamento a ele, estando grávida.
pt.B: Assim, também José subiu de Nazaré, na Galileia, para a Judeia, à cidade de Davi, Belém, porque era da casa e do clã de Davi. \v 5 Ele foi se registrar com Maria, que estava prometida em casamento a ele e esperava um filho.
pt.R: José morava na cidade de Nazaré, na Galileia. Ele era da família do rei Davi; por isso, teve de ir a Belém, na Judeia, a cidade onde Davi nasceu. \v 5 Ele foi para lá com Maria, para dar o nome na lista. Maria estava noiva de José e estava grávida.

am.L: ዮሴፍም ደግሞ ከገሊላ ከናዝሬት ከተማ ወደ ይሁዳ፣ ቤተ ልሔም ወደምትባለው ወደ ዳዊት ከተማ ወጣ፤ ከዳዊት ቤትና ወገን ነበረና፤ \v 5 [የወጣውም] ለእርሱ ከታጨችውና ፀንሳ ከነበረችው ከማርያም ጋር ሊመዘገብ [ነው]።
am.B: ስለዚህ ዮሴፍም ከዳዊት ቤትና ጎሳ ስለ ነበረ፣ ከገሊላ ከናዝሬት ወደ ይሁዳ፣ ወደ ዳዊት ከተማ ወደ ቤተ ልሔም ወጣ። \v 5 የሄደውም ለእርሱ ከታጨችውና ልጅ ከፀነሰችው ከማርያም ጋር ለመመዝገብ ነበረ።
am.R: ዮሴፍ በገሊላ በናዝሬት ከተማ ይኖር ነበር። እርሱ ከንጉሥ ዳዊት ቤተሰብ ስለ ነበረ፣ ዳዊት ወደ ተወለደባት ከተማ በይሁዳ ወዳለችው ወደ ቤተ ልሔም መሄድ ነበረበት። \v 5 በመዝገቡ ለመጻፍ ከማርያም ጋር ወደዚያ ሄደ። ማርያም ለዮሴፍ ታጭታ ነበር፤ ፀንሳም ነበረች።

ru.L: Пошёл же и Иосиф из Галилеи, из города Назарета, в Иудею, в город Давида, который называется Вифлеем, потому что он был из дома и рода Давида, \v 5 записаться с Марией, обручённой ему, которая была беременна.
ru.B: Так и Иосиф отправился из Назарета в Галилее в Иудею, в город Давида Вифлеем, потому что он был из дома и рода Давида. \v 5 Он пошёл записаться вместе с Марией, которая была с ним помолвлена и ждала ребёнка.
ru.R: Иосиф жил в городе Назарете в Галилее. Он был из рода царя Давида, поэтому ему нужно было идти в Вифлеем в Иудее, город, где родился Давид. \v 5 Он пошёл туда с Марией, чтобы их записали в список. Мария была помолвлена с Иосифом и была беременна.

hi.L: और यूसुफ़ भी गलील के नासरत नगर से ऊपर यहूदिया को, दाऊद के उस नगर को गया जो बैतलहम कहलाता है, क्योंकि वह दाऊद के घराने और कुल का था, \v 5 कि अपनी मंगेतर मरियम के साथ, जो गर्भवती थी, नाम लिखवाए।
hi.B: इसलिए यूसुफ़ भी गलील के नासरत से यहूदिया में दाऊद के नगर बैतलहम को गया, क्योंकि वह दाऊद के घराने और कुल का था। \v 5 वह मरियम के साथ नाम लिखवाने गया, जिससे उसकी मंगनी हुई थी और जो गर्भवती थी।
hi.R: यूसुफ़ गलील के नासरत नगर में रहता था। वह राजा दाऊद के परिवार से था, इसलिए उसे यहूदिया के बैतलहम नगर जाना पड़ा, जहाँ दाऊद का जन्म हुआ था। \v 5 वह अपना नाम सूची में लिखवाने के लिए मरियम के साथ वहाँ गया। मरियम की सगाई यूसुफ़ से हुई थी, और वह गर्भवती थी।

uk.L: Пішов же й Йосиф з Галилеї, з міста Назарета, до Юдеї, до міста Давида, що називається Вифлеєм, тому що він був з дому і роду Давида, \v 5 щоб записатися з Марією, зарученою з ним, яка була вагітна.
uk.B: Тож і Йосиф пішов із Назарета в Галилеї до Юдеї, до Давидового міста Вифлеєма, бо походив з дому і роду Давида. \v 5 Він пішов на перепис разом з Марією, своєю нареченою, яка чекала дитину.
uk.R: Йосиф жив у місті Назареті в Галилеї. Він походив з роду царя Давида, тому мусив іти до Вифлеєма в Юдеї, міста, де народився Давид. \v 5 Він пішов туди з Марією, щоб їх записали до списку. Марія була заручена з Йосифом і чекала дитину.

ja.L: そしてヨセフもまた、ガリラヤのナザレの町から、ユダヤの、ベツレヘムと呼ばれるダビデの町へ上って行った。彼がダビデの家と一族の出であったからである。\v 5 [それは]、彼と婚約していて、身ごもっていたマリアと共に登録するためであった。
ja.B: ヨセフもガリラヤの町ナザレを出て、ユダヤにあるダビデの町、ベツレヘムへ上って行った。ヨセフはダビデの家系に属し、その一族の出だったからである。\v 5 ヨセフは、婚約者のマリアと一緒に登録するために行った。マリアは子を宿していた。
ja.R: ヨセフは、ガリラヤ地方のナザレという町に住んでいました。ヨセフはダビデ王の家系の人だったので、ユダヤ地方のベツレヘムへ行かなければなりませんでした。ベツレヘムは、ダビデが生まれた町です。\v 5 ヨセフは、名簿に名前を載せてもらうために、マリアと一緒にそこへ行きました。マリアはヨセフと結婚の約束をしていて、おなかに赤ちゃんがいました。

decisions.choice: went up: travelled up to the hill country of Judea
decisions.reason: Bethlehem and Jerusalem stand high in the hills; Jewish speech always "went up" to them. The journey from Nazareth was about 90 miles.

decisions.choice: the city of David, Bethlehem: David's hometown
alternatives: Jerusalem, also called the city of David
decisions.reason: In the Old Testament "the city of David" usually means Jerusalem (2 Samuel 5:7). Luke uses it for Bethlehem, where David was born and anointed (1 Samuel 16:1-13), and where the ruler from David's line was to come from (Micah 5:2).

decisions.choice: betrothed: still engaged, not yet living together as husband and wife
decisions.reason: Luke still calls Mary betrothed (1:27). Many later manuscripts read "his betrothed wife" or "his wife".

decisions.choice: house and family: his descent, the larger line and the clan within it
decisions.reason: The two words name the line of David from wide to narrow.

decisions.choice: engaged
decisions.reason: As in 1:27.

decisions.choice: the reason (David's family) before the journey
decisions.reason: Readable explains first why Joseph had to go.

decisions.choice: comprometida
decisions.reason: "Desposada" is the older Bible word, but today it suggests a married woman. Mary was engaged and not yet living with Joseph (meaning decision m3), which "comprometida" says.

decisions.choice: ameposwa naye (L); amechumbiwa naye (B, R)
decisions.reason: Mary was engaged and not yet living with Joseph (meaning decision m3). "Kuposwa" is the formal betrothal, kept at Literal; "kuchumbiwa" is the everyday word for being engaged.

decisions.choice: "своєю нареченою" for "who was betrothed to him"
decisions.reason: "Наречена" is the natural Ukrainian word for a woman pledged to marry and still not living with her husband, which the meaning decision asks for; Literal keeps the participle "заручена".

decisions.choice: "婚約していて" (L), "婚約者" (B); "結婚の約束をしていて" (R); "身ごもっていた" (L), "子を宿していた" (B), "おなかに赤ちゃんがいました" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 1:18 in Japanese: Readable says "promised in marriage" and "had a baby in her" in everyday words.

source.text: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ ἐπλήσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ τεκεῖν αὐτήν, καὶ ἔτεκεν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς τὸν πρωτότοκον, καὶ ἐσπαργάνωσεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἀνέκλινεν αὐτὸν ἐν φάτνῃ, διότι οὐκ ἦν αὐτοῖς τόπος ἐν τῷ καταλύματι.

records.literal_gloss: It came to pass then in the being them there were fulfilled the days of the to give birth her, \v 7 and she bore the son of her the firstborn, and wrapped in cloths him and laid him in a manger, because not was for them a place in the guest room.

en.L: And it happened, while they were there, the days were completed for her to give birth, \v 7 and she gave birth to her son, the firstborn, and wrapped {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in strips of cloth and laid {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in a manger, because there was no place for them in the guest room.
en.B: While they were there, the days of her pregnancy came to an end, \v 7 and she bore her firstborn son. She wrapped {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} snugly in cloths and laid {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in a feeding trough, because the guest room had no space for them.
en.R: While they were in Bethlehem, the time came for Mary's baby to be born. \v 7 She gave birth to her first child, a son. She wrapped {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} tightly in strips of cloth and laid {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in a box where animals eat. They had to put {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} there because there was no room for them in the guest room of the house.

es.L: Y sucedió que, mientras ellos estaban allí, se cumplieron los días de dar ella a luz, \v 7 y dio a luz a su hijo, el primogénito, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} fajó con tiras de tela y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} recostó en un pesebre, porque para ellos no había sitio en la habitación de huéspedes.
es.B: Mientras estaban allí, se cumplió el tiempo de su embarazo, \v 7 y tuvo a su hijo primogénito. María {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} envolvió bien con tiras de tela y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} acostó en un comedero de animales, porque en la habitación de huéspedes no había espacio para ellos.
es.R: Mientras estaban en Belén, llegó el momento de que naciera el bebé de María. \v 7 Ella tuvo a su primer hijo, un varón. Ella {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} envolvió bien apretado con tiras de tela y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} acostó en un cajón donde comen los animales. Allí {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} tuvieron que poner, porque no había lugar para ellos en la habitación de huéspedes de la casa.

fr.L: Et il arriva, pendant qu’ils étaient là, que les jours où elle devait accoucher furent accomplis, \v 7 et elle mit au monde son fils, le premier-né, et elle {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}emmaillota et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} coucha dans une mangeoire, parce qu’il n’y avait pas de place pour eux dans la salle des hôtes.
fr.B: Pendant qu’ils étaient là, le temps où elle devait accoucher arriva, \v 7 et elle mit au monde son fils premier-né. Elle {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}enveloppa soigneusement de langes et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} coucha dans une mangeoire, car il n’y avait pas de place pour eux dans la pièce réservée aux hôtes.
fr.R: Pendant qu’ils étaient à Bethléem, le moment est venu pour Marie de mettre son bébé au monde. \v 7 Elle a donné naissance à son premier enfant, un fils. Elle {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a enveloppé bien serré dans des bandes de tissu, et elle {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a couché dans une mangeoire, là où mangent les animaux. Ils ont dû {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} mettre là parce qu’il n’y avait pas de place pour eux dans la chambre des invités de la maison.

sw.L: Ikatokea, walipokuwa huko, siku za yeye kujifungua zilitimia, \v 7 naye akamzaa mwanawe, mzaliwa wa kwanza, akamfunga kwa vitambaa, akamlaza katika hori, kwa sababu hapakuwa na nafasi kwa ajili yao katika chumba cha wageni.
sw.B: Walipokuwa huko, wakati wake wa kujifungua ulifika, \v 7 akamzaa mwana wake wa kwanza. Akamfunga vizuri kwa vitambaa, akamlaza katika hori ya kulishia wanyama, kwa sababu chumba cha wageni hakikuwa na nafasi kwa ajili yao.
sw.R: Walipokuwa Bethlehemu, wakati ulifika wa Mariamu kujifungua mtoto. \v 7 Akamzaa mtoto wake wa kwanza, wa kiume. Akamfunga vizuri kwa vipande vya kitambaa, akamlaza katika sanduku la kulishia wanyama. Walimlaza humo kwa sababu hapakuwa na nafasi kwao katika chumba cha wageni cha nyumba ile.

ko.L: 그리고 [이런] 일이 있었다. 그들이 거기에 있는 동안 그 여자가 해산할 날들이 찼다. \v 7 그리고 그 여자는 맏아들을 낳아, 그분을 천으로 싸서 구유에 누였다. 손님방에 그들을 위한 자리가 없었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그들이 그곳에 머무는 동안 마리아가 해산할 날이 되었다. \v 7 마리아는 첫아들을 낳아 천으로 감싸서 구유에 눕혔다. 손님방에는 그들이 있을 자리가 없었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그들이 베들레헴에 있는 동안 마리아가 아기를 낳을 때가 되었다. \v 7 마리아는 첫아들을 낳았다. 그리고 아기를 천으로 꼭 싸서 짐승들이 먹이를 먹는 구유에 눕혔다. 그 집의 손님방에는 그들이 있을 자리가 없어서, 아기를 거기에 눕혀야 했다.

vi.L: Và xảy ra, khi họ đang ở đó, những ngày sinh nở của cô đã trọn, \v 7 và cô sinh con trai đầu lòng của mình, và lấy khăn quấn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và đặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nằm trong máng cỏ, vì không có chỗ cho họ trong phòng khách.
vi.B: Trong khi họ ở đó, đến kỳ cô sinh nở, \v 7 và cô sinh con trai đầu lòng. Cô lấy khăn quấn kỹ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rồi đặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nằm trong máng cỏ, vì phòng dành cho khách không còn chỗ cho họ.
vi.R: Trong khi họ ở Bết-lê-hem, đến lúc Ma-ri sinh con. \v 7 Cô sinh con trai đầu lòng. Cô lấy khăn quấn chặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rồi đặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nằm trong máng cỏ, là chỗ đựng thức ăn cho gia súc. Họ phải đặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở đó vì phòng khách trong nhà không còn chỗ cho họ.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, enquanto eles estavam ali, completaram-se os dias para ela dar à luz, \v 7 e ela deu à luz o seu filho, o primogênito, e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} envolveu em faixas de pano e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} deitou numa manjedoura, porque não havia lugar para eles no quarto de hóspedes.
pt.B: Enquanto estavam ali, chegou ao fim o tempo da gravidez dela, \v 7 e ela deu à luz o seu filho primogênito. Ela {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} envolveu bem em panos e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} deitou num cocho, porque no quarto de hóspedes não havia espaço para eles.
pt.R: Enquanto eles estavam em Belém, chegou a hora de o bebê de Maria nascer. \v 7 Ela deu à luz o seu primeiro filho, um menino. Ela {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} enrolou bem em faixas de pano e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} deitou num cocho, onde os animais comem. Eles tiveram de colocá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ali porque não havia lugar para eles no quarto de hóspedes da casa.

am.L: በዚያም ሳሉ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የምትወልድበት ቀኖች ተፈጸሙ፤ \v 7 ልጇን፣ በኩሩን ወለደች፤ በጨርቅም ጠቀለለችው፤ በግርግምም አስተኛችው፤ በእንግዶች ማረፊያው ስፍራ አልነበራቸውምና።
am.B: በዚያ ሳሉ የእርግዝናዋ ቀኖች ተፈጸሙ፤ \v 7 የበኩር ልጇንም ወለደች። በጨርቅ አጥብቃ ጠቀለለችው፤ በእንግዶቹ ማረፊያ ክፍል ቦታ ስላልነበራቸውም በግርግም አስተኛችው።
am.R: በቤተ ልሔም ሳሉ ማርያም የምትወልድበት ጊዜ ደረሰ። \v 7 የመጀመሪያ ልጇን ወንድ ልጅ ወለደች። በጨርቅ አጥብቃ ጠቀለለችው፤ እንስሳት በሚበሉበት ገንዳ ውስጥም አስተኛችው። በዚያ ያስተኙት በቤቱ የእንግዶች ክፍል ውስጥ ቦታ ስላልነበራቸው ነው።

ru.L: И было, когда они были там, исполнились дни родить ей, \v 7 и родила она сына своего, первенца, и запеленала {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, и положила {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} в ясли, потому что не было им места в комнате для гостей.
ru.B: Пока они были там, подошло время ей родить, \v 7 и она родила своего первенца, сына. Она туго запеленала {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} и положила в кормушку для скота, потому что в комнате для гостей не нашлось для них места.
ru.R: Пока они были в Вифлееме, Марии пришло время родить. \v 7 Она родила своего первого ребёнка, сына. Она туго завернула {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} в пелёнки и положила в кормушку, из которой ели животные. Им пришлось положить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} туда, потому что в комнате для гостей в доме не было места.

hi.L: और ऐसा हुआ कि जब वे वहाँ थे, तो उसके जनने के दिन पूरे हुए, \v 7 और उसने अपने पहलौठे पुत्र को जन्म दिया, और उन्हें कपड़े की पट्टियों में लपेटकर चरनी में लिटाया, क्योंकि उनके लिए मेहमानों के कमरे में जगह न थी।
hi.B: जब वे वहाँ थे, तो उसके प्रसव के दिन पूरे हुए, \v 7 और उसने अपने पहलौठे पुत्र को जन्म दिया। उसने उन्हें कपड़ों में अच्छी तरह लपेटा और चारे की एक नाँद में लिटा दिया, क्योंकि मेहमानों के कमरे में उनके लिए जगह नहीं थी।
hi.R: जब वे बैतलहम में थे, तब मरियम के बच्चे के जन्म का समय आ गया। \v 7 उसने अपने पहले बच्चे, एक बेटे को जन्म दिया। उसने उन्हें कपड़े की पट्टियों में कसकर लपेटा और जानवरों के चारा खाने की नाँद में लिटा दिया। उन्हें वहाँ इसलिए लिटाना पड़ा क्योंकि घर के मेहमानवाले कमरे में उनके लिए जगह नहीं थी।

uk.L: І сталося, коли вони були там, сповнилися дні їй народити, \v 7 і вона народила свого сина, первістка, і сповила {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, і поклала {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} в ясла, бо не було для них місця в кімнаті для гостей.
uk.B: Коли вони були там, настав час їй народжувати, \v 7 і вона народила свого первістка, сина. Вона сповила {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} і поклала {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} в ясла, бо в кімнаті для гостей не було для них місця.
uk.R: Поки вони були у Вифлеємі, настав час Марії народжувати. \v 7 Вона народила свою першу дитину, сина. Вона туго сповила {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} і поклала {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} в годівницю для тварин. Їм довелося покласти {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} туди, бо в кімнаті для гостей у домі не було для них місця.

ja.L: そして、彼らがそこにいる間に[次のことが]起こった。彼女が産む日々が満ちた。\v 7 そして彼女は、自分の息子である初子を産み、その子を布にくるんで、飼い葉おけに寝かせた。客間には彼らのための場所がなかったからである。
ja.B: 二人がそこにいる間に、マリアは月が満ちて、\v 7 初子である男の子を産んだ。マリアはその子を布でしっかりとくるみ、飼い葉おけに寝かせた。客間には二人のいる場所がなかったからである。
ja.R: 二人がベツレヘムにいる間に、マリアの赤ちゃんが生まれる時が来ました。\v 7 マリアは、最初の子どもである男の子を産みました。そして、その子を布でしっかりとくるんで、家畜のえさ箱に寝かせました。その家の客間には、二人がいられる場所がなかったので、そこに寝かせるしかなかったのです。

decisions.choice: firstborn: her first child, who has the rights of the firstborn
decisions.reason: The word says he was her first son, and prepares for the law about the firstborn in 2:22-23. It does not by itself say whether other children followed.

decisions.choice: wrapped him in strips of cloth: the usual care for a newborn
decisions.reason: Babies were wrapped tightly in bands of cloth (Ezekiel 16:4; Wisdom of Solomon 4:4). It shows the child was cared for as any baby would be. Together with the manger it is the sign given to the shepherds (2:12).

decisions.choice: manger: a feeding trough for animals
decisions.reason: The noun is a trough or crib for fodder. Luke mentions no stable; houses in the region often kept animals in a lower room at night, with troughs in the floor or the wall.

decisions.choice: the guest room: a room for guests in a house
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word for the upper room where Jesus ate the Passover (22:11), and a different word for an inn (10:34). Joseph and Mary were probably staying in a house whose guest room was full, and the baby was laid where the animals were fed.

decisions.choice: feeding trough (B); a box where animals eat (R); manger (L)
decisions.reason: Many readers know "manger" only from Christmas cards. Balanced and Readable say what it was.

decisions.choice: They had to put him there because
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the lack of room is why the baby was laid in the trough.

decisions.choice: pesebre (L); comedero de animales (B); un cajón donde comen los animales (R)
decisions.reason: As the English (meaning decision m3): "pesebre" is the familiar word, but many readers now think of a nativity scene. Balanced and Readable say what it was. The same in 2:12 and 2:16.

decisions.choice: la habitación de huéspedes
decisions.reason: The word is a room for guests in a house (meaning decision m4). "Mesón" and "posada" would say an inn.

decisions.choice: une mangeoire at every level; Readable adds "là où mangent les animaux"
decisions.reason: English uses "manger" only at Literal because many readers know it only from Christmas cards. The same is true of French "crèche", which today means a nativity scene or a day nursery; "mangeoire" is the plain word for a feeding trough, so every level can use it (m3). Readable adds a short explanation, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: la salle des hôtes (L); la pièce réservée aux hôtes (B); la chambre des invités de la maison (R)
decisions.reason: The word means a room for guests in a house (m4). "Hôtellerie" and "auberge" would suggest a commercial inn, which the meaning decision does not support.

decisions.choice: hori (L); hori ya kulishia wanyama (B); sanduku la kulishia wanyama (R)
decisions.reason: As the English (meaning decision m3): "hori" is the word for a feeding trough, but not every reader knows it, so Balanced adds what it is for and Readable describes it. The same in 2:12 and 2:16.

decisions.choice: chumba cha wageni
decisions.reason: The word is a room for guests in a house (meaning decision m4). "Nyumba ya wageni" is a guesthouse or inn today.

decisions.choice: "구유" for the manger at every level; "손님방" for the guest room
decisions.reason: "구유" is the ordinary Korean word for an animals' feeding trough, so Korean needs no separate Balanced word as the English does; Readable adds what it is for. The meaning decision reads the Greek word as a room for guests in a house, not an inn, so Korean says "손님방"; the footnote gives the other reading.

decisions.choice: "máng cỏ" at every level, explained once at Readable
decisions.reason: "máng cỏ" is the plain Vietnamese word for a feeding trough and the word readers know from the Christmas story, so Balanced needs no other word; Readable adds what it is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "phòng khách" (L, R); "phòng dành cho khách" (B)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the guest room of a house, not an inn; "quán trọ" would bring back the reading the decision footnotes.

decisions.choice: manjedoura (L); cocho (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Manjedoura" is the word Brazilian readers know from the nativity scene, and Literal keeps it. Balanced and Readable say "cocho", the everyday Brazilian word for an animal's feeding trough, as the English says "feeding trough" (m3); nothing in the text mentions a stable.

decisions.choice: o quarto de hóspedes
decisions.reason: As the English and the meaning note (m4): the word is a guest room in a house; "hospedaria" would make it an inn.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God and Jesus has nothing to change in Amharic; the pronouns (እርሱ, the object suffixes such as ጠቀለለችው, the verb endings) are written once, with no span.

decisions.choice: ግርግም (manger, L, B); እንስሳት በሚበሉበት ገንዳ (a trough animals eat from, R); የእንግዶች ማረፊያ (the guest room)
alternatives: የከብቶች መመገቢያ (a feeding place for cattle) at B
decisions.reason: "ግርግም" is the ordinary Amharic word for an animals' feeding trough, so Balanced needs no other; Readable describes it, as the English Readable does. The Greek word for the place with no room is a house's guest room (as at 22:11), so it is not called an inn.

decisions.choice: 'ясли' (L); 'кормушка для скота' (B); 'кормушка, из которой ели животные' (R)
decisions.reason: 'Ясли' is the familiar word, but today it first means a nursery for small children. Literal keeps it; Balanced and Readable say what it was.

decisions.choice: 'комната для гостей'
decisions.reason: The Greek word is the guest room of a house, as the meaning decision says, not an inn.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi. Respect for Jesus is carried by the honorific third person ("उन्हें", "उनका"), which Luke's narrative gives him from his birth, at every level.

decisions.choice: "चरनी" (L); "चारे की नाँद" (B); "जानवरों के चारा खाने की नाँद" (R)
decisions.reason: The manger is a feeding trough for animals (meaning decision). Literal keeps the familiar word; Balanced and Readable say what it was, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "मेहमानों का कमरा"
decisions.reason: The word means a guest room in a house (meaning decision), not a public inn, which "सराय" would suggest.

decisions.choice: "ясла" (L, B), "годівниця для тварин" (R)
decisions.reason: "Ясла" is the right Ukrainian word for a feeding trough and the one readers know from this story; because it now also means a nursery, Readable says what it was.

decisions.choice: "кімната для гостей"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as a guest room in a house, not an inn, so Ukrainian avoids "заїзд" and "гостиниця".

decisions.choice: "飼い葉おけ" (L, B), "家畜のえさ箱" (R); "客間" (every level)
decisions.reason: 飼い葉おけ already says what the manger was, a trough for fodder; Readable uses the plainest words. The guest room is a room in a house (m4), not an inn, so 客間 rather than the familiar 宿屋.

decisions.choice: "その子を"
decisions.reason: Japanese does not add 彼 for Jesus where a noun or nothing will do; Literal says "the child" for the pronoun.

source.text: Καὶ ποιμένες ἦσαν ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ τῇ αὐτῇ ἀγραυλοῦντες καὶ φυλάσσοντες φυλακὰς τῆς νυκτὸς ἐπὶ τὴν ποίμνην αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: And shepherds were in the region the same living in the fields and keeping watches of the night over the flock of them.

en.L: And there were shepherds in the same region, living in the fields and keeping watch over their flock by night.
en.B: In the same area there were shepherds out in the open country, taking turns to guard their flock through the night.
en.R: That night, some shepherds were in the fields near Bethlehem. They were staying out there to guard their sheep.

es.L: Y había unos pastores en esa misma región que pasaban la noche a la intemperie y hacían guardias nocturnas sobre su rebaño.
es.B: En esa misma zona había unos pastores que vivían en el campo abierto y se turnaban para cuidar su rebaño durante la noche.
es.R: Esa noche, unos pastores estaban en el campo cerca de Belén. Se quedaban allí afuera para cuidar sus ovejas.

fr.L: Et il y avait dans la même région des bergers qui vivaient aux champs et montaient la garde de nuit auprès de leur troupeau.
fr.B: Dans cette même région, des bergers vivaient en plein champ et se relayaient pour garder leur troupeau pendant la nuit.
fr.R: Cette nuit-là, des bergers étaient dans les champs près de Bethléem. Ils restaient dehors pour garder leurs moutons.

sw.L: Na kulikuwa na wachungaji katika eneo hilo hilo, wakilala nje kondeni na kuweka ulinzi wa usiku juu ya kundi lao.
sw.B: Katika eneo hilo hilo kulikuwa na wachungaji waliokuwa wakiishi nje mbugani, wakipokezana kulinda kundi lao usiku kucha.
sw.R: Usiku ule, wachungaji fulani walikuwa nje kondeni karibu na Bethlehemu. Walikaa huko ili kulinda kondoo wao.

ko.L: 그리고 그 지역에 목자들이 들에서 지내며 밤에 자기들의 양 떼를 지키고 있었다.
ko.B: 그 지역에는 들에서 밤을 지내며 번갈아 양 떼를 지키는 목자들이 있었다.
ko.R: 그날 밤 베들레헴 근처 들판에 목자들이 있었다. 그들은 밖에서 지내며 양들을 지키고 있었다.

vi.L: Và trong cùng vùng ấy có những người chăn chiên ở ngoài đồng, thức canh bầy chiên mình trong đêm.
vi.B: Cũng trong vùng ấy, có mấy người chăn chiên ở ngoài đồng, thay phiên nhau canh giữ bầy chiên suốt đêm.
vi.R: Đêm đó, có mấy người chăn chiên đang ở ngoài cánh đồng gần Bết-lê-hem. Họ ở ngoài đó để canh giữ bầy chiên của mình.

pt.L: E havia pastores naquela mesma região, que ficavam nos campos e faziam as vigílias da noite sobre o seu rebanho.
pt.B: Na mesma região havia pastores que estavam no campo e se revezavam para vigiar o rebanho durante a noite.
pt.R: Naquela noite, alguns pastores estavam nos campos perto de Belém. Eles estavam passando a noite ali para guardar as ovelhas.

am.L: በዚያው አካባቢም እረኞች ነበሩ፤ በሜዳ ውስጥ ያድሩና በሌሊት በየተራ መንጋቸውን ይጠብቁ ነበር።
am.B: በዚያው አካባቢ በሜዳ ላይ የነበሩ እረኞች መንጋቸውን ሌሊቱን ሁሉ በየተራ ይጠብቁ ነበር።
am.R: በዚያ ሌሊት አንዳንድ እረኞች በቤተ ልሔም አጠገብ በሜዳ ላይ ነበሩ። በጎቻቸውን ለመጠበቅ በዚያ ያድሩ ነበር።

ru.L: И были в той же местности пастухи, жившие в поле и стерегущие ночные стражи у стада своего.
ru.B: В той же местности были пастухи, которые ночевали в поле и по очереди стерегли ночью своё стадо.
ru.R: В ту ночь недалеко от Вифлеема в поле были пастухи. Они оставались там, чтобы охранять своих овец.

hi.L: और उसी इलाक़े में चरवाहे थे, जो मैदान में रहकर रात को अपने झुंड का पहरा देते थे।
hi.B: उसी इलाक़े में कुछ चरवाहे खुले मैदान में थे, जो बारी-बारी से रात भर अपने झुंड की रखवाली कर रहे थे।
hi.R: उस रात बैतलहम के पास के खेतों में कुछ चरवाहे थे। वे अपनी भेड़ों की रखवाली करने के लिए वहीं रुके हुए थे।

uk.L: І були пастухи в тій самій околиці, що перебували в полі і несли нічну варту над своєю отарою.
uk.B: У тій самій місцевості були пастухи, які ночували в полі й по черзі стерегли свою отару вночі.
uk.R: Тієї ночі кілька пастухів були в полі біля Вифлеєма. Вони залишалися там, щоб стерегти своїх овець.

ja.L: そして、同じ地方に、野宿をしながら、夜に自分たちの群れの見張りをしている羊飼いたちがいた。
ja.B: その地方では、羊飼いたちが野宿をしながら、夜通し交代で羊の群れの番をしていた。
ja.R: その夜、ベツレヘムの近くの野原に、羊飼いたちがいました。羊飼いたちは外で寝泊まりして、羊の番をしていました。

decisions.choice: shepherds: working men of low standing
decisions.reason: Shepherds did hard, poor work and were often away from home and the synagogue. God's news comes first to them, as Mary sang (1:52). David too was a shepherd of Bethlehem (1 Samuel 16:11).

decisions.choice: keeping watches of the night: guarding in shifts through the night
decisions.reason: The plural "watches" suggests that they took turns.

decisions.choice: taking turns to guard
decisions.reason: Balanced brings out the plural.

source.text: καὶ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἐπέστη αὐτοῖς καὶ δόξα κυρίου περιέλαμψεν αὐτούς, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν φόβον μέγαν·

records.literal_gloss: And an angel of [the] Lord stood by them and [the] glory of [the] Lord shone around them, and they feared fear great;

en.L: And an angel of [the] Lord stood before them, and [the] glory of [the] Lord shone around them, and they feared with great fear.
en.B: An angel of the Lord stood before them, and the glory of the Lord blazed around them, and they were struck with great fear.
en.R: Suddenly an angel of the Lord stood in front of them. The glory of the Lord shone all around them, and they were very frightened.

es.L: Y un ángel del Señor se presentó ante ellos, y [la] gloria del Señor brilló a su alrededor, y temieron [con] gran temor.
es.B: Un ángel del Señor se puso delante de ellos, y la gloria del Señor resplandeció a su alrededor, y un gran miedo se apoderó de ellos.
es.R: De repente, un ángel del Señor apareció delante de ellos. La gloria del Señor brilló alrededor de ellos, y se asustaron muchísimo.

fr.L: Et un ange du Seigneur se tint devant eux, et la gloire du Seigneur resplendit autour d’eux, et ils craignirent d’une grande crainte.
fr.B: Un ange du Seigneur se présenta devant eux, et la gloire du Seigneur les enveloppa de sa lumière ; une grande peur s’empara d’eux.
fr.R: Tout à coup, un ange du Seigneur s’est trouvé devant eux. La gloire du Seigneur a brillé tout autour d’eux, et ils ont eu très peur.

sw.L: Na malaika wa Bwana akasimama karibu nao, na utukufu wa Bwana ukaangaza kuwazunguka, nao wakaogopa hofu kubwa.
sw.B: Malaika wa Bwana alisimama mbele yao, na utukufu wa Bwana ukawaka kwa nuru kuwazunguka, wakashikwa na hofu kubwa.
sw.R: Ghafla malaika wa Bwana alisimama mbele yao. Utukufu wa Bwana ukaangaza pande zote kuwazunguka, nao wakaogopa sana.

ko.L: 그리고 주님의 천사가 그들 곁에 섰고, 주님의 영광이 그들 둘레를 비추었다. 그리고 그들은 큰 두려움으로 두려워하였다.
ko.B: 그때 주님의 천사가 그들 앞에 섰고, 주님의 영광이 그들 둘레를 환히 비추었다. 그들은 몹시 두려워했다.
ko.R: 갑자기 주님의 천사가 그들 앞에 나타났다. 주님의 영광이 그들 둘레를 환하게 비추었다. 목자들은 몹시 무서웠다.

vi.L: Và một thiên sứ của Chúa đứng bên họ, và vinh quang của Chúa chiếu sáng chung quanh họ, và họ rất đỗi sợ hãi.
vi.B: Một thiên sứ của Chúa đứng trước mặt họ, và vinh quang của Chúa chói lòa chung quanh họ. Họ vô cùng kinh hãi.
vi.R: Bỗng nhiên, một thiên sứ của Chúa đứng trước mặt họ. Vinh quang của Chúa chiếu sáng khắp chung quanh, và họ rất sợ hãi.

pt.L: E um anjo do Senhor se pôs diante deles, e [a] glória do Senhor brilhou ao redor deles, e temeram com grande temor.
pt.B: Um anjo do Senhor apareceu diante deles, e a glória do Senhor resplandeceu ao redor deles, e eles ficaram tomados de grande medo.
pt.R: De repente, um anjo do Senhor apareceu na frente deles. A glória do Senhor brilhou em volta deles, e eles ficaram com muito medo.

am.L: የጌታም መልአክ በአጠገባቸው ቆመ፤ የጌታም ክብር በዙሪያቸው አንጸባረቀ፤ ታላቅ ፍርሃትንም ፈሩ።
am.B: የጌታ መልአክ በፊታቸው ቆመ፤ የጌታም ክብር በዙሪያቸው ተንቦገቦገ፤ እነርሱም በታላቅ ፍርሃት ተያዙ።
am.R: በድንገት የጌታ መልአክ በፊታቸው ቆመ። የጌታ ክብር በዙሪያቸው ሁሉ አበራ፤ እነርሱም በጣም ፈሩ።

ru.L: И ангел Господа предстал перед ними, и слава Господа осияла их, и они испугались страхом великим.
ru.B: Перед ними встал ангел Господа, и слава Господа засияла вокруг них, и их охватил великий страх.
ru.R: Вдруг перед ними появился ангел Господа. Слава Господа засияла вокруг них, и они очень испугались.

hi.L: और प्रभु का एक स्वर्गदूत उनके पास आ खड़ा हुआ, और प्रभु की महिमा उनके चारों ओर चमकी, और वे बड़े भय से डर गए।
hi.B: प्रभु का एक स्वर्गदूत उनके सामने आ खड़ा हुआ, और प्रभु की महिमा उनके चारों ओर जगमगा उठी, और वे बहुत डर गए।
hi.R: अचानक प्रभु का एक स्वर्गदूत उनके सामने आ खड़ा हुआ। प्रभु की महिमा का प्रकाश उनके चारों ओर चमकने लगा, और वे बहुत डर गए।

uk.L: І ангел Господа став перед ними, і слава Господа осяяла їх, і вони злякалися великим страхом.
uk.B: Ангел Господа став перед ними, і слава Господа засяяла довкола них, і їх охопив великий страх.
uk.R: Раптом перед ними став Господній ангел. Слава Господа засяяла навколо них, і вони дуже злякалися.

ja.L: そして主の天使が彼らのそばに立ち、主の栄光が彼らの周りを照らした。そして彼らは大きな恐れで恐れた。
ja.B: すると、主の天使が彼らの前に立ち、主の栄光が周りを明るく照らしたので、彼らはひどく恐れた。
ja.R: 突然、主の天使が羊飼いたちの前に立ちました。主の栄光が周りじゅうを明るく照らし、羊飼いたちはとてもこわくなりました。

decisions.choice: the glory of the Lord: the bright presence of God
decisions.reason: In the Old Testament God's glory is his visible presence, as a shining light or cloud (Exodus 16:10; 40:34; Ezekiel 1:28). It surrounds the shepherds in the fields.

decisions.choice: they feared with great fear: they were terrified
decisions.reason: The verb with its own noun makes it strong, a Hebrew way of speaking (compare Jonah 1:10).

decisions.choice: "rất đỗi sợ hãi" for "they feared a great fear" (L)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese cannot repeat the verb as a noun the way the Greek does without sounding wrong; "rất đỗi" keeps the strength the idiom has.

decisions.choice: "大きな恐れで恐れた" (L); "ひどく恐れた" (B); "とてもこわくなりました" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the verb with its own noun (m2), which Japanese can say stiffly; Balanced and Readable give the sense.

source.text: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ ἄγγελος· Μὴ φοβεῖσθε, ἰδοὺ γὰρ εὐαγγελίζομαι ὑμῖν χαρὰν μεγάλην ἥτις ἔσται παντὶ τῷ λαῷ, ὅτι ἐτέχθη ὑμῖν σήμερον σωτὴρ ὅς ἐστιν χριστὸς κύριος ἐν πόλει Δαυίδ·

records.literal_gloss: And said to them the angel, Not fear, behold for I announce good news to you of joy great which will be to all the people, \v 11 because was born to you today a Savior who is Christ Lord in city of David;

en.L: And the angel said to them, "Do not be afraid, for look, I bring you good news of great joy, which will be for all the people: \v 11 that today in [the] city of David a Savior has been born to you, who is {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} [the] Lord.
en.B: But the angel said to them, "Do not fear. I am bringing you good news, a great joy that is for all the people. \v 11 Today, in David's town, a Savior has been born for you: {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, the Lord.
en.R: But the angel said, "Do not be afraid. I have good news for you, news that will bring great joy to all the people. \v 11 Today a baby was born for you in David's town. He is the Savior who will rescue you. He is {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, the Lord.

es.L: Y el ángel les dijo: «No {{plural_you:teman|temáis}}, porque {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} anuncio la buena noticia de una gran alegría que será para todo el pueblo: \v 11 que para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ha nacido hoy un Salvador, que es {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} [el] Señor, en [la] ciudad de David.
es.B: Pero el ángel les dijo: «No {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} traigo una buena noticia, una gran alegría para todo el pueblo. \v 11 Hoy ha nacido para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} un Salvador en el pueblo de David: {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, el Señor.
es.R: Pero el ángel les dijo: «No {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} traigo una buena noticia, una noticia que llenará de alegría a todo el pueblo. \v 11 Hoy nació un bebé para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en el pueblo de David. Él es el Salvador que {{plural_you:los|os}} va a rescatar. Él es {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, el Señor.

fr.L: Et l’ange leur dit : « N’ayez pas peur, car voici, je vous annonce la bonne nouvelle d’une grande joie, qui sera pour tout le peuple : \v 11 aujourd’hui, dans la ville de David, un Sauveur vous est né, qui est {{christos:Christ|Messie}} [et] Seigneur.
fr.B: Mais l’ange leur dit : « Soyez sans crainte. Je vous apporte une bonne nouvelle, une grande joie destinée à tout le peuple. \v 11 Aujourd’hui, dans la ville de David, un Sauveur est né pour vous : c’est le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, le Seigneur.
fr.R: Mais l’ange leur a dit : « N’ayez pas peur. J’ai une bonne nouvelle pour vous, une nouvelle qui va remplir de joie tout le peuple. \v 11 Aujourd’hui, un bébé est né pour vous dans la ville de David. C’est le Sauveur qui va vous délivrer. C’est le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, le Seigneur.

sw.L: Na malaika akawaambia, "Msiogope, kwa maana tazama, ninawatangazia habari njema: furaha kubwa ambayo itakuwa kwa watu wote, \v 11 kwa sababu leo amezaliwa kwenu Mwokozi, ambaye ni {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Bwana, katika mji wa Daudi.
sw.B: Lakini malaika akawaambia, "Msiogope. Ninawatangazia habari njema, furaha kubwa kwa ajili ya watu wote. \v 11 Leo Mwokozi amezaliwa kwa ajili yenu katika mji wa Daudi. Yeye ni {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Bwana.
sw.R: Lakini malaika akawaambia, "Msiogope. Nina habari njema kwa ajili yenu, habari itakayowaletea watu wote furaha kubwa. \v 11 Leo mtoto amezaliwa kwa ajili yenu katika mji wa Daudi. Yeye ndiye Mwokozi atakayewaokoa. Yeye ni {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Bwana.

ko.L: 그러자 천사가 그들에게 말했다. "두려워하지 마라. 보라, 내가 온 백성에게 있을 큰 기쁨을 너희에게 기쁜 소식으로 전한다. \v 11 오늘 다윗의 성읍에서 너희를 위하여 구원자가 태어나셨으니, 그분은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 주님이시다.
ko.B: 천사가 그들에게 말했다. "두려워하지 마라. 내가 너희에게 기쁜 소식을 전한다. 온 백성에게 큰 기쁨이 될 소식이다. \v 11 오늘 다윗의 마을에서 너희를 위하여 구원자가 태어나셨다. 그분은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}이신 주님이시다.
ko.R: 그러나 천사가 말했다. "무서워하지 마라. 내가 너희에게 기쁜 소식을 가지고 왔다. 모든 백성에게 큰 기쁨이 될 소식이다. \v 11 오늘 다윗의 마을에서 너희를 위하여 한 아기가 태어나셨다. 그분은 너희를 구원하실 구원자이시다. 그분은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}이시며 주님이시다.

vi.L: Và thiên sứ nói với họ: "Đừng sợ, vì này, tôi báo cho các anh tin vui về một niềm vui lớn, là [niềm vui] sẽ đến cho cả dân chúng: \v 11 hôm nay, trong thành Đa-vít, một Cứu Chúa đã sinh ra cho các anh, là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, Chúa.
vi.B: Nhưng thiên sứ nói với họ: "Đừng sợ. Tôi báo cho các anh một tin vui, một niềm vui lớn cho cả dân tộc. \v 11 Hôm nay, tại thành Đa-vít, một Cứu Chúa đã ra đời cho các anh, là {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, là Chúa.

am.R: መልአኩ ግን እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «አትፍሩ። ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ ታላቅ ደስታ የሚያመጣ የምሥራች ይዤላችሁ መጥቻለሁ። \v 11 ዛሬ በዳዊት ከተማ አንድ ሕፃን ተወልዶላችኋል። እርሱ የሚያድናችሁ አዳኝ ነው። እርሱ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}}፣ ጌታ ነው።

ja.L: すると天使は彼らに言った。「恐れることはない。見なさい、わたしは、民全体のものとなる大きな喜びを、あなたがたに福音として告げ知らせるのだから。\v 11 [それは]、今日ダビデの町で、あなたがたのために救い主がお生まれになったということである。この方は{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}、主である。

ja.R: しかし天使は言いました。「こわがらなくてよい。あなたたちに良い知らせを持って来たのだ。民全体にとって大きな喜びとなる知らせだ。\v 11 今日、ダビデの町で、あなたたちのために赤ちゃんがお生まれになった。この方こそ、あなたたちを救ってくださる救い主だ。この方は{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}であり、主である。

decisions.choice: I bring good news: I announce news of God's saving act
decisions.reason: The verb of 1:19. In the Roman world the same language was used for the birth or victory of an emperor; here the good news is the birth of a different Savior and Lord.

decisions.choice: all the people: the people of Israel
decisions.reason: The singular "the people" in Luke usually means Israel (1:68, 77; 2:32). Simeon will add the nations (2:31-32).

decisions.choice: a Savior, who is Christ the Lord: three titles together
decisions.reason: This is the only place in the New Testament where "Christ" and "Lord" stand side by side without a joining word. "Savior" was used of God (1:47) and of emperors; "Christ" is the anointed king of David's line; "Lord" has been used of God all through chapter 1. The child is all three.

decisions.choice: today: the day of fulfillment has come
decisions.reason: "Today" is a key word in Luke for the arrival of God's salvation (4:21; 19:9; 23:43).

decisions.choice: the Savior who will rescue you
decisions.reason: Readable explains the title.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The angel's "for look" introduces the reason not to fear. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence, as in Matthew 1:20.

decisions.choice: plural_you spans on the angel's words to the shepherds ({{plural_you:teman|temáis}}, {{plural_you:les|os}}, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}})
decisions.reason: Spanish has two plural forms of "you": "ustedes" (Latin America, the default) and "vosotros" (Spain); the reader setting chooses between them. English has no such choice, so these spans have no English counterpart. The same for every plural "you" in Luke. "Look" said to a group is plural too ({{plural_you:miren|mirad}}).

decisions.choice: voici (L); not rendered as a separate word (B, R)
decisions.reason: English Literal says "look" because "behold" is old-fashioned. French "voici" is still the ordinary word for pointing to something new, so Literal keeps it; Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Christ / Messie [et] Seigneur
decisions.reason: The two titles stand side by side with no article (m3). French cannot set two bare nouns next to each other as English Literal does with "[the]"; a bracketed "et" shows that both are titles of the one Savior.

decisions.choice: "{{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 주님" (L); "{{christos:그리스도|메시아}}이신 주님" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The christos setting as in the Korean John and Mark. The particle after the span fits both forms, since "그리스도" and "메시아" both end in a vowel. The angel speaks of the newborn with the honorific ("태어나셨다"), as Gabriel does in 1:32.

decisions.choice: The angel speaks to the shepherds as "các anh" and of himself as "tôi"
decisions.reason: Shepherds are working men; "các anh" is a friendly, respectful address that fits good news. As with Zechariah (1:13), the angel says "tôi", leaving "Ta" for God.

decisions.choice: "{{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}"
decisions.reason: Every Christos takes the christos setting, in the style guide's form for the title.

decisions.choice: {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} (Christ, or Messiah)
decisions.reason: Christos is the Greek word for the Hebrew title Messiah, the anointed king. The reader's setting chooses between the familiar title "ክርስቶስ" and "መሲሕ", which shows the meaning. Amharic has no article, so both read naturally at every level; this holds for every Christos in Luke.

decisions.choice: 'вот' (L); not rendered (B, R)
decisions.reason: As settled in Matthew, idou is 'вот' at Literal and left out at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "मसीह" with no christos span
decisions.reason: The English offers "Christ" or "the Messiah" as a setting. Hindi "मसीह" is both the familiar name in "यीशु मसीह" and the word Messiah itself, so the choice the setting offers is already made and the Hindi has no span.

decisions.choice: "देखो" (L); not rendered (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in chapter 1: Literal keeps "idou" as "देखो"; Balanced and Readable carry its force in the sentence.

decisions.choice: "福音として告げ知らせる" (L), "告げ知らせる" (B), "良い知らせを持って来た" (R); "救い主"
decisions.reason: The verb of good news is 福音を告げ知らせる at Literal, as in Acts; Balanced keeps 告げ知らせる with the joy as its object, and Readable says 良い知らせ, the Readable word for the gospel.

decisions.choice: "お生まれになった" in the angel's words
decisions.reason: The angel speaks of the Savior and Lord, so his words use the light respect form that the narration uses for Jesus.

decisions.choice: the sign: what will let them recognize the child, and confirm the message
decisions.reason: Many babies were born in Bethlehem; one lying in a feeding trough would be easy to find. The humble sign is part of the message: the Lord lies in a manger.

decisions.choice: feeding trough (B); box where animals eat (R)
decisions.reason: As in 2:7.

decisions.choice: "표적" (L, B); "표시" (R)
decisions.reason: "표적" is the word the Korean Gospels keep for this Greek word (style guide, section 6); here it is a mark to recognise the child by (meaning decision), so Readable says "표시", a plain sign to know him by, never "기적" (miracle).

decisions.choice: "dấu hiệu" for the sign
decisions.reason: John's "dấu lạ" names a miraculous sign that points to who Jesus is; here the sign is a mark by which the shepherds will recognize the child, as the meaning decision says. The same in 2:34.

decisions.choice: "しるし"
decisions.reason: The sign both lets them find the child and confirms the message (m1); しるし, the word used for signs through the Gospels, carries both.

source.text: καὶ ἐξαίφνης ἐγένετο σὺν τῷ ἀγγέλῳ πλῆθος στρατιᾶς οὐρανίου αἰνούντων τὸν θεὸν καὶ λεγόντων·

records.literal_gloss: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of army heavenly praising the God and saying,

en.L: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of [the] heavenly army, praising God and saying,
en.B: All at once the angel was joined by a great crowd of heaven's army, who praised God and said,
en.R: Then, all at once, a huge army of angels from heaven was there with the angel. They were praising God and saying,

es.L: Y de repente hubo junto con el ángel una multitud del ejército celestial, alabando a Dios y diciendo:
es.B: Al instante se unió al ángel una gran multitud del ejército del cielo, que alababa a Dios y decía:
es.R: Entonces, de pronto, apareció con el ángel un enorme ejército de ángeles del cielo. Alababan a Dios y decían:

fr.L: Et soudain, avec l’ange, il y eut une multitude de l’armée du ciel, qui louaient Dieu en disant :
fr.B: Tout à coup, une grande foule de l’armée du ciel rejoignit l’ange ; ils louaient Dieu et disaient :
fr.R: Puis, tout d’un coup, une immense armée d’anges venus du ciel est apparue avec l’ange. Ils louaient Dieu en disant :

sw.L: Na kwa ghafla kukawa pamoja na malaika umati wa jeshi la mbinguni, ukimsifu Mungu na kusema,
sw.B: Mara moja kundi kubwa la jeshi la mbinguni likaungana na malaika yule, likimsifu Mungu na kusema,
sw.R: Kisha, ghafla, jeshi kubwa la malaika kutoka mbinguni likawa pale pamoja na malaika yule. Walikuwa wakimsifu Mungu wakisema,

ko.L: 그리고 갑자기 그 천사와 함께 하늘 군대의 무리가 [나타나] 하나님을 찬양하며 말했다.
ko.B: 그러자 갑자기 수많은 하늘 군대가 그 천사와 함께 나타나 하나님을 찬양하며 말했다.
ko.R: 그때 갑자기 하늘에서 온 수많은 천사들이 그 천사와 함께 있었다. 그들은 하나님을 찬양하며 말했다.

vi.L: Và bỗng nhiên có một đoàn đông đảo của đạo binh trên trời cùng với thiên sứ ấy, ngợi khen Đức Chúa Trời và nói:
vi.B: Bỗng nhiên, một đoàn đông đảo của đạo binh trên trời hiện ra cùng với thiên sứ ấy, ngợi khen Đức Chúa Trời và nói:
vi.R: Rồi bỗng nhiên, có rất đông thiên sứ từ trời hiện ra cùng với thiên sứ ấy, như một đạo quân. Họ ngợi khen Đức Chúa Trời và nói:

pt.L: E de repente surgiu com o anjo uma multidão do exército celestial, louvando a Deus e dizendo:
pt.B: De repente, uma grande multidão do exército do céu se juntou ao anjo, louvando a Deus e dizendo:
pt.R: Então, de repente, um enorme exército de anjos do céu apareceu ali com o anjo. Eles louvavam a Deus e diziam:

am.L: ድንገትም ከመልአኩ ጋር ብዙ የሰማይ ሠራዊት ሆነ፤ እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገኑ እንዲህ ይሉ ነበር፦
am.B: ወዲያውም ብዙ የሰማይ ሠራዊት ከመልአኩ ጋር ተቀላቅሎ እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገነ እንዲህ አለ፦
am.R: ከዚያም በድንገት ከሰማይ የመጡ እጅግ ብዙ መላእክት ከመልአኩ ጋር ታዩ። እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገኑ እንዲህ አሉ፦

ru.L: И внезапно было с ангелом множество небесного воинства, хвалящих Бога и говорящих:
ru.B: И вдруг вместе с ангелом появилось великое множество небесного воинства. Они славили Бога и говорили:
ru.R: И тут вдруг рядом с ангелом появилось огромное войско ангелов с неба. Они славили Бога и говорили:

hi.L: और अचानक उस स्वर्गदूत के साथ स्वर्गीय सेना का एक बड़ा दल था, जो परमेश्वर की स्तुति करते हुए कह रहा था,
hi.B: एकाएक उस स्वर्गदूत के साथ स्वर्ग की सेना का एक बड़ा दल आ मिला, जो परमेश्वर की स्तुति करके कह रहा था,
hi.R: फिर अचानक स्वर्ग से स्वर्गदूतों की एक बहुत बड़ी सेना उस स्वर्गदूत के साथ आ गई। वे परमेश्वर की स्तुति कर रहे थे और कह रहे थे,

uk.L: І раптом зʼявилася з ангелом безліч небесного війська, що хвалили Бога і казали:
uk.B: І враз до ангела приєдналася велика безліч небесного війська. Вони хвалили Бога і казали:
uk.R: І раптом разом з ангелом зʼявилося величезне військо ангелів з неба. Вони хвалили Бога і казали:

ja.L: すると突然、その天使と共に、天の軍勢の大群が[現れ]、神を賛美して言った。
ja.B: すると突然、天の軍勢の大群がその天使に加わり、神を賛美して言った。
ja.R: すると突然、天から来た天使の大軍が、その天使と一緒にいました。天使たちは神を賛美して言いました。

decisions.choice: the heavenly army: the angels, God's host
decisions.reason: "The host of heaven" can mean the stars (Deuteronomy 4:19), but here it is the angels who serve God like an army (1 Kings 22:19). The LORD of hosts is the LORD of these armies.

decisions.choice: heaven's army
decisions.reason: "Host" in this sense is old-fashioned. Balanced says "army".

decisions.choice: "하늘 군대" (L, B); "천사들" (R)
decisions.reason: The heavenly army is the angels, God's host (meaning decision). "천군" is the older church word; "하늘 군대" keeps the picture in plain words, and Readable names the angels.

decisions.choice: "天の軍勢の大群" (L, B); "天から来た天使の大軍" (R)
decisions.reason: The heavenly army is the angels (m1). Literal and Balanced keep the picture of an army; Readable says that they were angels.

source.text: Δόξα ἐν ὑψίστοις θεῷ καὶ ἐπὶ γῆς εἰρήνη ἐν ἀνθρώποις εὐδοκίας.

records.literal_gloss: Glory in highest [places] to God and on earth peace among men of good pleasure.

en.L: "Glory to God in [the] highest [places], \q and on earth peace among {{gender:people|men}} of [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] good pleasure."
en.B: "Glory to God in the heights of heaven, \q and on earth peace to the people {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} favors!"
en.R: "Give glory to God in heaven! \q And on earth, peace to the people God is pleased with!"

es.L: «Gloria a Dios en [las] alturas, \q y en [la] tierra paz entre {{gender:las personas|los hombres}} de [{{deity_pronoun:su|Su}}] beneplácito».
es.B: «¡Gloria a Dios en lo más alto de los cielos, \q y en la tierra paz a la gente que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} favorece!».
es.R: «¡Gloria a Dios en el cielo! \q ¡Y en la tierra, paz para la gente con la que Dios está contento!».

fr.L: « Gloire à Dieu dans les [lieux] les plus hauts, \q et sur la terre paix parmi les {{gender:humains|hommes}} de [{{deity_pronoun:son|Son}}] bon plaisir. »
fr.B: « Gloire à Dieu dans les hauteurs du ciel, \q et sur la terre, paix à ceux qui ont {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} faveur ! »
fr.R: « Rendez gloire à Dieu dans le ciel ! \q Et sur la terre, paix aux gens qui plaisent à Dieu ! »

sw.L: "Utukufu kwa Mungu katika [mahali] palipo juu kabisa, \q na juu ya nchi amani kati ya watu wa radhi [{{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}]."
sw.B: "Utukufu kwa Mungu katika mbingu za juu kabisa, \q na duniani amani kwa watu anaowafadhili!"
sw.R: "Mpeni Mungu utukufu mbinguni! \q Na duniani iwe amani kwa watu ambao Mungu anapendezwa nao!"

ko.L: "가장 높은 곳들에서는 하나님께 영광, \q 땅에서는 [그분이] 기뻐하시는 사람들 가운데 평안!"
ko.B: "하늘 가장 높은 곳에서는 하나님께 영광, \q 땅에서는 그분이 기뻐하시는 사람들에게 평안!"
ko.R: "하늘에서는 하나님께 영광을 돌려라! \q 땅에서는 하나님께서 기뻐하시는 사람들에게 평안이 있기를!"

vi.L: "Vinh quang [thuộc về] Đức Chúa Trời trên các nơi chí cao, \q và bình an trên đất giữa những người [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] đẹp lòng."
vi.B: "Vinh quang cho Đức Chúa Trời trên nơi chí cao, \q và bình an dưới đất cho những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đẹp lòng!"
vi.R: "Vinh quang thuộc về Đức Chúa Trời trên trời cao! \q Và bình an dưới đất cho những người Đức Chúa Trời hài lòng!"

pt.L: "Glória a Deus nas alturas, \q e na terra paz entre {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}} do [{{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}}] agrado."
pt.B: "Glória a Deus no mais alto dos céus, \q e na terra paz às pessoas sobre quem repousa o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} favor!"
pt.R: "Deem glória a Deus lá no céu! \q E que haja paz na terra para as pessoas de quem Deus se agrada!"

am.L: «ክብር በአርያም ለእግዚአብሔር፣ \q በምድርም ሰላም [የእርሱ] በጎ ፈቃድ ባረፈባቸው ሰዎች መካከል።»
am.B: «በሰማያት ከፍታ ለእግዚአብሔር ክብር ይሁን፤ \q በምድርም እርሱ ሞገሱን ለሰጣቸው ሰዎች ሰላም ይሁን!»
am.R: «በሰማይ ለእግዚአብሔር ክብር ስጡ! \q በምድርም እግዚአብሔር ደስ ለሚሰኝባቸው ሰዎች ሰላም ይሁን!»

ru.L: «Слава Богу в высших [небесах], \q и на земле мир среди людей [{{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}] благоволения.»
ru.B: «Слава Богу в небесной вышине, \q и на земле мир людям, к которым {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} благоволит!»
ru.R: «Слава Богу на небесах! \q А на земле мир людям, которыми Бог доволен!»

hi.L: "सबसे ऊँचे स्थानों में परमेश्वर की महिमा, \q और पृथ्वी पर [उनकी] प्रसन्नता के लोगों में शान्ति।"
hi.B: "स्वर्ग की ऊँचाइयों में परमेश्वर की महिमा हो, \q और पृथ्वी पर उन लोगों को शान्ति मिले जिन पर उनकी कृपा है!"
hi.R: "स्वर्ग में परमेश्वर की महिमा करो! \q और पृथ्वी पर उन लोगों को शान्ति मिले जिनसे परमेश्वर प्रसन्न हैं!"

uk.L: «Слава Богові на висотах, \q і на землі мир серед людей [{{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}] уподобання.»
uk.B: «Слава Богові на небесних висотах, \q і на землі мир людям, яких {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} уподобав!»
uk.R: «Славте Бога на небі! \q А на землі — мир людям, якими Бог задоволений!»

ja.L: 「最も高い所では神に栄光、 \q そして地の上では、[神が]喜ばれる人々の間に平和。」
ja.B: 「天の高い所では神に栄光があるように。 \q 地上では、神が喜ばれる人々に平和があるように。」
ja.R: 「天の神に栄光をささげよう！ \q 地上では、神が喜ばれる人々に平和があるように！」

decisions.choice: of good pleasure, the reading of the SBLGNT: peace to those God favors
alternatives: good pleasure, the reading of many later manuscripts: goodwill toward people
decisions.reason: The difference is one letter. The oldest manuscripts have the form that means "people of his good pleasure"; many later ones read "peace on earth, goodwill toward people", known from the King James Version. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: people of his good pleasure: the people on whom God's favor rests
alternatives: people of good will, who deserve peace
decisions.reason: The good pleasure is God's, as in 3:22 and 10:21. The same phrase appears in Hebrew in the Dead Sea Scrolls. Peace is God's gift to those he chooses, not a reward for their goodwill.

decisions.choice: glory to God ... peace on earth: praise and announcement, with no verb
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb. The two lines balance each other: glory in heaven, peace on earth. They both praise God and declare what the birth brings.

decisions.choice: Give glory
decisions.reason: Readable supplies a verb.

decisions.choice: de [su] beneplácito
decisions.reason: "Buena voluntad" is easily read as the good will of the people. The word is God's favor (meaning decisions m1, m2), so Literal uses "beneplácito" and supplies whose it is, as the English does.

decisions.choice: ¡Gloria a Dios en el cielo!
decisions.reason: The English Readable supplies "Give". A Spanish command would have to choose a plural "you" the Greek does not have; the exclamation "¡Gloria a Dios!" is plain Spanish for new readers and says the same.

decisions.choice: les humains (default), les hommes (gender setting alternative)
decisions.reason: The Greek word means human beings, men and women. French "les hommes" is read as generic less and less, so the default says "les humains" and the traditional word is the alternative (style guide 7). Balanced and Readable avoid the noun ("ceux qui", "les gens") and need no span.

decisions.choice: no gender span on "watu"
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender span (people/men). Swahili "watu" already means people of both sexes, and "wanaume" would mean males only, so there is nothing for the setting to change. The same in 2:52.

decisions.choice: "평안" for peace; "[그분이] 기뻐하시는 사람들" (L), "그분이 기뻐하시는 사람들" (B), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The Korean Gospels keep "평안" for this word (style guide, section 6), linking the song to 1:79 and 2:29. The SBLGNT reads "of good pleasure", the people God favors (meaning decision); Literal brackets the subject Korean needs. "사람" includes women and men, so no setting span is needed.

decisions.choice: "Vinh quang thuộc về Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: Glory is a key term with one word at every level; "thuộc về" makes the verbless praise plain without changing the noun into a command.

decisions.choice: "những người" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "người" already includes men and women.

decisions.choice: as pessoas sobre quem repousa o seu favor
decisions.reason: The good pleasure is God's (m2), so Balanced says that his favor rests on these people; "homens de boa vontade" follows the later reading the meaning note sets aside and would make peace a reward for their goodwill.

decisions.choice: 'мир среди людей Его благоволения' (L); 'мир людям, к которым Он благоволит' (B)
decisions.reason: The Synodal follows a later reading of the Greek. The SBLGNT has 'of good pleasure', so the peace is for the people God favours, as the meaning decision says.

decisions.choice: "серед людей" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The Greek means human beings, and Ukrainian "люди" already says that, so the English setting is not needed.

decisions.choice: "平和"
decisions.reason: The peace announced is God's peace with people, coming to earth, not inner calm, so 平和 by the style guide's rule.

decisions.choice: "人々" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender span on people/men. Japanese 人々 already means men and women.

decisions.choice: "[神が]喜ばれる人々" (L); "神が喜ばれる人々" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The good pleasure is God's (m2), so Japanese names God as the one who is pleased, in its own wording rather than a familiar church phrase.

source.text: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἀπῆλθον ἀπ’ αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν οἱ ἄγγελοι, οἱ ποιμένες ἐλάλουν πρὸς ἀλλήλους· Διέλθωμεν δὴ ἕως Βηθλέεμ καὶ ἴδωμεν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο τὸ γεγονὸς ὃ ὁ κύριος ἐγνώρισεν ἡμῖν.

records.literal_gloss: And it came to pass as went away from them into the heaven the angels, the shepherds were speaking to one another, Let us go indeed to Bethlehem and let us see the word this the having happened which the Lord made known to us.
